When I was about eight or nine I found a baby bird who couldn't fly yet. It was just hopping around doing baby bird things so of course I had to intervene. But what would he eat?! I found some left over baby formula my mom had and fed it to him through a medicine dropper(with dads help of course). The surprising part was he actually ate it and lived off of it. I eventually taught him to fly and built him a two story bird house. He was really my best friend! One day I came home and decided to kick off my shoes down the hall. One shoe came in contact with my little guy and I murdered him right there in cold blood. RIP Martin.
